children: This is the history subpage for the Archer. It contains every revision of the tower's statistics.
Firerate is seperated into two parts, loading the bow, and aiming and firing the bow. The firerate is halved if the bow is already loaded.
Total Elapsed Damage is calculated as Burn Damage × Burn Time.
DPS assumes one arrow successfully hits one enemy only.
Total DPS is calculated as Normal DPS + Burn DPS.
Burn DPS is calculated as Burn Damage ÷ Tick.
Refers to the arrow only, not the explosion.
DPS assumes one arrow successfully hits one enemy only.
